mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at its current level (0.18%) is below the historical threshold of 0.5%, and this low rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPI) exceeds 225.0 (the current index value is 220.252), it signals elevated inflation that may prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and the Consumer Price Index exceeds 225.0, it signals a high-risk environment of low rates and high inflation, prompting monetary policy uncertainty and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550.0 (the current value is 555.0), it signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 550.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 (the current value is 94.8756), it indicates a contraction in the industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and private sector employment (PAYEMS) falls below 130000.0 (thousands), it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 AND PAYEMS < 130000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) fall below 380000.0 (the current value is 380869.0), it signals a weakening consumer sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS < 380000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
